lede: Stanford carries a full EdgeDesk team rating at -4.0; Elon is not one of the 138 FBS programmes EdgeDesk rates, so the comparison is one-sided by construction rather than by judgement.
EdgeDesk makes it Stanford -17.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Stanford winning 88% of simulations.

The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; Elon is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 47% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
